sources.name: CSS Logical Properties and Values Level 1

provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

statement.ar: الأنماط تستخدم الخصائص والقيم المنطقية (inline-start/end، margin-inline، padding-inline، inset-inline، border-start-*-radius، text-align: start، float: inline-start) ولا تذكر left وright إلا في ما هو فيزيائي بطبيعته.
statement.en: Styles use logical properties and values (inline-start/end, margin-inline, padding-inline, inset-inline, border-start-*-radius, text-align: start, float: inline-start) and mention left and right only for what is physical by nature.

rationale.ar: ورقة أنماط واحدة تخدم الاتجاهين دون نسخة RTL تُنسى عند التعديل، وتعمل للعناصر المتداخلة المختلفة الاتجاه.
rationale.en: One stylesheet serves both directions with no RTL copy to forget when editing, and it works for nested elements of a different direction.

checks: The built CSS contains no margin-left/right, padding-left/right, left:, right:, border-left/right, text-align: left/right, float: left/right or clear: left/right outside an allowlist with a stated reason.
No [dir=rtl] selector overrides a physical property that a logical one could express.
Each component's RTL screenshot equals the horizontal mirror of its LTR screenshot, except for regions listed as not mirrored.
